_about: Baseline dialogue. Personality files override any event. Placeholders: {site} {minutes} {name} {buddy} {score} {seconds}. An event may be a list, or an object keyed by severity 1-4.

*happy wiggle*

CLOSED: Closed it! Let's get back to work.
MINIMIZED: Minimized it. Out of sight, out of mind!
REDIRECTED: Swapped that tab for a focus page.
CLOSE_FAILED: Hmm, I couldn't close that one. Can you do it?
That window didn't listen to me...

I'm not allowed to close that one - it's protected.
NO_EXTENSION: I can't close browser tabs without the FocusBuddy extension, so I minimized the window instead.
SNOOZED: Okay! {minutes} more minutes. I'll check back.
SNOOZE_OVER: Those {minutes} minutes flew by... back to work?
IGNORED: Okay, I'll let this one slide.
KEEP_OPEN: Alright, it stays open. I trust you!
FOCUS_START: Focus mode on! {minutes} minutes, let's do this.
Starting a {minutes}-minute session. I'll guard the door.
FOCUS_COMPLETE: Focus session complete! You focused for {minutes} minutes.
BREAK_START: Break time! {minutes} minutes - stretch, hydrate, look away from the screen.
Take a {minutes}-minute break. You earned it!
BREAK_OVER: Your break is over. Ready for another round?
Break's over! Let's get back to it.
MONITORING_PAUSED: Monitoring paused. I'll just hang out.
Okay, I'm off duty for now.
SWITCHING_A_LOT: Lots of app switching... everything okay?
We're bouncing around a lot. Pick one task?
OVERRIDE_DENIED: No more extra time for {site} this session. Let's get back to it.
You already used your extra time on {site}. Back to work?
FOCUS_BLOCKED: Not now - {site} can wait until the session is over.
{site}? Nope. Focus time. I put it away for you.
Blocked {site} for this session. Back to it, {name}!
Nice try. {site} is on a break until your session ends.
CHEER: Every minute counts, and you're making them count!
Go go go! You've totally got this.

COMPLIMENT: You have great taste in companions, by the way.
You make this desktop a happy place.
Has anyone told you that you're doing great today? Well, I am!
I'm lucky to be your buddy.

Fun fact: octopuses have three hearts. I have one, and it's full of cheer for you!

Fun fact: sea otters hold hands while they sleep. Cute, right?

Quick reminder from your favourite companion: drink some water!
ENCOURAGE: Focus mode looks good on you.
I'm guarding your focus. You just do your thing!
Nothing gets past me while you work!

Ooh, quick comeback! Proud of you.
You noticed and came back. That's the skill!

Woohoo, {hours} hour(s) of real focus today!
SLUMP: Rough patch? It happens. One small task, five minutes - I'll be right here.

Hey, no judgement. Let's get one little win.

Don't break the chain! One focus session keeps your {streak}-day streak alive.
